headline: Papermaking centre among projects from Swinburne University of Technology students
context: Dezeen School Shows: a centre for developing handmade paper is among the projects from students at Swinburne University of Technology. Also featured is a tool to support those living with dementia and a mural that reflects the role of women and technology in the design industry.
